item.title: Accounting
item.description:
This demo publishes one query, invoice-paid, and sets service.query_authoring.enabled to false. A request that does not match that skill does not start a watch.

PostgreSQL listens on 127.0.0.1:5432. Inspector listens on http://127.0.0.1:8081/.

cd examples/accounting-local-demo
cp .env.example .env
./demo.sh

In Inspector, click Send streaming and send:

Tell me when an invoice is paid. Keep the watch for 7 days.

When the subscription is active, run the printed docker exec update. The seeded unpaid invoice enters the result set. The artifact diffType is Add.

item.title: Building comfort
item.description:
This demo starts the PostgreSQL building, floor, and room source from the Drasi building comfort tutorial. The catalog has no queries. query_authoring.enabled is true.

PostgreSQL listens on 127.0.0.1:5732. Inspector listens on http://127.0.0.1:8085/. Port 5432 belongs to the accounting demo.

cd examples/building-comfort-local-demo
cp .env.example .env
./demo.sh

Send one watch per task. A comfort level you define in the message is part of the query, not a stored column. After the subscription is active, the demo README prints the docker exec update that pushes one floor out of band.

item.title: Curbside
item.description:
Orders live in PostgreSQL on 127.0.0.1:5433. Vehicles live in MySQL on 127.0.0.1:3309. The catalog has no queries. The agent builds each watch from a prompt, one task at a time. Inspector is at http://127.0.0.1:8083/.

cd examples/curbside-local-demo
./demo.sh

Click Send streaming. Wait until the subscription is active before you send the next watch. A later watch request in the same Inspector session starts another task. The first watch keeps its stream. A mapping answer stays on the task that asked.

item.title: Invoice overdue
item.description:
This example is not an anonymous demo. Copy secrets/secrets.json.example to secrets/secrets.json, mode 0600, and fill in the CDC password, CDC port, and JWT public key. Set the Azure OpenAI variables, then run:

cd examples/invoice-overdue
dotnet run --project ../../src/Drasi.Sentinel.Host -- sentinel.yaml

Connect Inspector to the Agent Card, click Send streaming, and send:

Tell me when an invoice is overdue. Keep the watch for 7 days.

Keep the stream open, or reconnect with tasks/subscribe and Last-Event-ID. The caller must present the JWT the manifest expects.
